feat(ui): sinker EDM machine setup and op pages

The Machine window gains a Sinker EDM section for a sinker_edm machine:
max orbit radius, electrode pickup, the orbit list, the condition table
and the edm.codes roles, with "not stated" for absent values and the
loader's refusal named beside the section. Edits ride the existing
undoable EditMachineApply. Edm::is_sane now refuses a blank pickup as
the file loader does. The Sinker Burn page reads the typed condition's
gap and undersize from the mounted machine.

Fixes #548

fix(ui): the Machine window's EDM problems follow #560's condition law

problems() now judges each condition with the loader's own
condition_refusal (id spelling, gap > 0, undersize in (0, 1] mm), compares
ids as the loader does (case and leading zeros ignored), and names a
wire-only field on a sinker. Ticking a gap / undersize seeds 0.01 / 0.1 mm
(values the loader accepts) instead of 0. Add condition skips ids that
collide by the loader's key. post exports condition_refusal and
condition_id_key for it.

Pinned by sinker_machine_tests::problems_name_each_law_the_loader_keeps
(page and Edm::is_sane / Machine::edm_sane agree on every case).

Refs #548
